parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Use information in Table 1.1 to show that the SI base unit of $\alpha$ is $\mathrm{s^{-1}}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Show that the percentage uncertainty in $\alpha$ is $15\%$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Calculate $\alpha$ with its absolute uncertainty. Give your answer to an appropriate number of significant figures.

$\alpha = (\ldots\ldots\ldots\ldots\ldots\;\pm\;\ldots\ldots)\times10^7\,\mathrm{s^{-1}}$

stem:
The rate of flow $Q$ of a liquid along a narrow pipe of length $L$ and radius $r$ is given by

$$Q=\frac{\alpha r^4}{L}$$

where $\alpha$ is a constant.

An experiment is carried out to determine the value of $\alpha$. The data from the experiment are shown in Table 1.1.

Table 1.1

| quantity | value | percentage uncertainty |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $Q$ | $2.72\times10^{-8}\,\mathrm{m^3\,s^{-1}}$ | $\pm3\%$ |
| $r$ | $7.1\times10^{-5}\,\mathrm{m}$ | $\pm2\%$ |
| $L$ | $2.5\times10^{-2}\,\mathrm{m}$ | $\pm4\%$ |
